status: Draft / HOLD — Phase A post-generation descriptive review
selection_discipline: All100 native outcomes reviewed after immutable preregistration; no replacements. Benchmark selection is intentionally post-review and does not alter the registered100. Earlier public SWARM evidence informed the preregistered strata; this is not a blinded sample.
interpretation: Labels are architectural/editorial judgments, not numerical truth. Component counts do not certify support or traversal. SWARM-001 control comparisons do not measure SWARM-002 presolve negotiation.
